objective.sign_note: Without the leading minus sign on the expectation, the stated uncapped supremum is infinite even for constant actions.

population.return_definition: one-day spot and fixed-cash-strike option price increments divided by pre-step spot; expiry-day option increments use settlement payoff
population.policy_features: 16 cumulative Brownian factor histories, log spot, 44 live log option-price/spot ratios, calendar time, and four times to expiry
population.split: adjacent paths are antithetic pairs; complete pairs [0,25000) form 50000-path training sample A and complete pairs [25000,50000) form 50000-path held-out sample B
population.split_integrity: all path-time observations remain with their complete path and both members of every antithetic pair remain in the same sample

policy.architecture: uncapped signed affine plus two-layer width-32 SiLU network
policy.forward_checkpoint_source: fitted in this invocation on sample A only
policy.normalization: fitted on sample A only and frozen on sample B
policy.heldout_use: sample B is used once after training; it is not used for early stopping, tuning, normalization, or checkpoint selection

affine_only_baseline.role: convex affine A-only baseline and initialization for the full affine-plus-deep policy

heldout_tail_diagnostic.interpretation: Spot-normalized increments avoid dividing by tiny option prices. Tilted effective sample size and maximum log payoff diagnose any remaining concentration in the exponential loss.

unconditional_spot_scaled_martingale_aud.null_hypothesis: E_Q[(V_{t+1}^i-V_t^i)/S_t]=0 for every day and instrument
unconditional_spot_scaled_martingale_aud.sampling_unit: complete antithetic path pair; each day-instrument coordinate is tested separately

reverse_crossfit.fixed_hyperparameters: The B-to-A fold uses the identical architecture, optimizer, epoch count, and line-search configuration selected before examining either held-out fold.
reverse_crossfit.normalization: B-to-A feature normalization is fitted on B only and frozen before evaluating A.

action_outer_moment.definition: E_{path,time}[a_t a_t'] with expired coordinates zero
